## 兼容性说明

为了避免升级 Jellyfin 12 后可能与 Jellyfin 10.11 不兼容的情况，保留此版本作为 Jellyfin 10.11 的最后一个版本。

后续插件将不再考虑 Jellyfin 10.11 的兼容性，若出现不兼容情况，可以下载此版本。

## 新功能与改进

- 增加按用户管理 Bangumi 授权，以及 NSFW 播放记录的私密上报选项。
- 增加缺失 Bangumi ID 的补全工具和 `bangumi.ini` 媒体库管理功能，改进批量选择及刷新反馈。
- 增加动画搜索偏好和优先使用原始标题搜索的配置，支持自定义 Bangumi 网站地址。
- 引入 Anitomy 剧集解析器，改进文件名、集数和多季度识别。
- 增强音乐元数据与播放记录同步，调整插件设置页面。

## 问题修复

- 修复 Bangumi 图片地址和搜索结果处理问题。
- 修复剧集与季度未读取 `bangumi.ini`、未知季度和重复剧集扫描中的特别篇识别问题。
- 修复音乐刮削中的元数据丢失及艺人类型筛选问题。
- 修复 infobox 解析死循环及重复字段处理。
- 改进异步请求、取消操作、评分刷新和播放状态缓存处理。

versions.changelog: Release v0.2.7.7 - Fixed the real cause of 'Telegram only sends when I click Test': every event-type checkbox (Playback Start, Stop, etc.) defaulted to off, so real playback events were silently dropped at the delivery queue's event-enablement check while the Test button, which bypasses that check, kept working. New installs now default Start/Stop to on, and existing installs are auto-recovered at save time if notifications and a destination are active with zero event types ever configured -- without overriding an explicit choice made in the same save. Saving Discord or Telegram settings now also persists the current event-subscription checkboxes, instead of only the separate Preferences section doing so. Fixed 'Copy Diagnostic Report' being permanently blocked when opened from Jellyfin's own standard Dashboard -> Plugins route, which always carries a '?name=playbackcard' query string the report's own validator was rejecting. Poster image upload failures (Discord, Telegram) no longer drop the notification outright, both now fall back to a plain text message if the image itself gets rejected. Parallelized the Local Network/Remote geolocation lookups so a page with several concurrent remote sessions and a cold cache no longer waits on them one at a time.

Release v0.2.7.6 - Discord/Telegram notifications now attach the item's poster image directly, uploaded as part of the same request rather than a link back to the server, so it works even on servers that aren't internet-reachable; falls back to text-only when no image is cached (on by default, can be turned off). The summary strip gains a live bandwidth gauge showing total outbound bitrate, split by Local Network vs. Remote when that badge is enabled, plus an optional percentage against an admin-configured upload limit. Sessions paused a while now show a warning pill (escalating from amber to red past an hour) so a forgotten paused stream holding server resources doesn't go unnoticed, and a badge appears when one account has more than one stream running. The Send Message admin action now offers quick-fill presets, and the Info panel gets a Copy Report button producing a sanitized per-session technical summary (no username, device, or IP) for sharing in a forum post or issue. Added a Recent Sessions shelf -- a short in-memory history of finished playback, cleared on restart, no database. Also fixes two Telegram bugs: saving a bot token no longer requires a Chat ID to already be set, and notification duration text no longer wraps past 24 hours.

Release v0.2.7.5 - Added a second Info view: click Info while 'Right' is selected (next to the existing 'Down' toggle) to open a centered dialog with the poster on the left and the full Tautulli-style Product/Player/Quality/Stream/Container/Video/Audio/Subtitle/Location/Bandwidth field list on the right, instead of expanding the card in place. The original Down behavior is unchanged. Transcode reasons are now itemized with red/amber severity, shown both as a details-panel banner and as warning rings on the affected pills, so it is clear at a glance why a stream is transcoding and how serious it is. Compact/Extended switches and opening Info now animate instead of snapping open. Also adds a strictly opt-in (off by default) Local Network/Remote badge, with an optional city/country lookup for remote sessions via a third-party geolocation service -- the raw IP address is never exposed or logged.

Release v0.2.7.4 - Added detection for stale, superseded plugin version folders left behind after an update. Jellyfin's own plugin loader can, in rare cases, silently keep running an old build instead of a newer one already installed (a real bug in Jellyfin itself, tracked upstream as jellyfin/jellyfin#17699) -- when that happens, fixes from later releases never take effect, with no error shown anywhere. The plugin now checks for this at every startup and logs a warning if found, and the System Diagnostics section shows a banner naming the older folder(s) with an explicit 'Remove' button per folder. Removal is always an admin-confirmed, one-click action -- never automatic -- and it refuses to remove anything unless it can positively confirm the folder belongs to this plugin and is strictly older than the version currently running.

Moonfin, Finamp, and Streamyfin icons now match their real app logos instead of approximate shapes. versions.changelog:
✨ New Features

- Added support for 10.11.7
- Due to the security warning issued with the release of 10.11.7, all previous 10.11.x versions have been discontinued effective immediately to promote upgrading to the more secure version

✨ New Features

- Added localization to the admin settings page, currently localized to English and German (PR #223, @Arny80Hexa)

🪲 Bug Fixes

- Fixed issue where lazy load page wouldn't load properly if there was a break in the order indices (PR #222, @Arny80Hexa)
- Fixed issue where localization wouldn't work for default instance language (PR #209, @gallyamb)
- Fixed issue where discover cards wouldn't load poster URLs from cache if jellyfin hosted under sub-directory path

🌐 Translations

- Added Korean translations (PR #211, @juiz4231-ship-it)
- Added Catalan translations (PR #215, @Kisnov)

✨ New Features

- Add support for Jellyfin Enhanced modals for discover cards. Allows users with private Seerr instances to still present the data without taking their user to a site that can't be accessed (PR #202, @n00bcodr)
- Add support for ratings to appear on discover cards, requires [Jellyfin Enhanced](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced) (PR #205, @n00bcodr)

🪲 Bug Fixes

- Fixed performance issues with the "Latest" sections. These now incrementally request 30 days of content at a time until the library is exhausted.
- Fixed #198; Sort order for combined next up and continue watching section was incorrectly being handled. Additionally performance for this section has improved approx 2.5x (PR #200, @AdamWHY2K)

🪲 Bug Fixes

- Further fixes to performance issues, this time more wholesale across all the supported sections. I found a different way to get items from the library which seems to be significantly quicker than the old approach.

🌐 Translations

- Added Russian translations (PR #191, @gallyamb)
- Added Mexican Spanish translations (PR #194, @josephmora)

🪲 Bug Fixes

- Fixed issue where LatestShows/LatestMovies was really really slow. I've personally seen a 15x speed improvement when collecting items from this section

✨ New Features

- Added support for 10.11.6

🪲 Bug Fixes

- Fixed #177 - Added support for hiding watched episodes in the combined Continue Watching / Next Up section (PR #178, @AdamWHY2K)

🌐 Translations

- Added Turkish translations (PR #186, @dgkndemir)
- Added Czech translations (PR #187, @vdobes)

🪲 Bug Fixes

- Fixed #176 and https://github.com/IAmParadox27/jellyfin-plugin-file-transformation/issues/33, Solves issue where dll scan could happen on missing directory causing the plugin to malfunction

🪲 Bug Fixes

- Fixed #173; Order index 0 was previously being mishandled in the new section logic, this has now been rectified so previous configurations should continue to work.
- Fixed LiveTV localization key being inconsistent with section key

✨ New Features

- Added "Continue Watching / Next Up" combined section. Closes: https://features.iamparadox.dev/posts/46/add-the-option-to-combine-next-up-and-continue-watching
- Added offline translation support as a preferred alternative to LibreTranslate. Translations are community driven and pulled daily into the plugin if there is an internet connection, otherwise it will only use the embedded translations. Initially supported languages are; English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Brazilian Portuguese, Swedish, Dutch. Please note these translations have been done using AI and if there are any issues please open a PR to rectify them.
- Added lazy loading support for the home screen, this new feature means that home screens should load quicker and will dynamically load new sections as the user scrolls to the bottom of the page. As time goes on this feature papers the way for a truly infinite home screen. Future releases will include more configuration properties, for now the only configurables are whether to enable lazy loading and how many sections per page there are.

🪲 Bug Fixes

- Fixed #130; Images are now dynamically resized if too large to avoid very high quality posters that aren't necessary (PR #139, @AdamWHY2K)
- Fixed #159; LG WebOS clients wouldn't be functional at all due to DOM incompatibilities that have now been fixed (PR #170, @WoolMagician)

🌐 Translations

- Added Hungarian translation (PR #172, @Gabor2180)

🔜 Coming Soon

- "Starring" and "Directed By" sections will soon be added to HSS! I've been working hard on trying to get these sections ready for this release but unfortunately the performance of them isn't at the level I'd like for release so these have been disabled for the time being.

🎉 Thank you!

- I'd just like to also say a massive thank you to everyone who's started using Home Screen Sections this year, as well as those contributing to its improvements, its been amazing to see in the 10 months since my initial release the amount of use and love my plugins get and I just wanted to say a huge thank you! For those who celebrate it I hope you have a great Christmas, for those that don't I hope 2025 has been a wonderful year for you. I wish you all a very happy new year, and an amazing 2026! Thank you again!

✨ New Features

- Updated to support 10.11.5

⚡ Performance Improvements

- Optimized Latest Shows, Genre and Watch Again sections to avoid using N+1 complexity algorithms (PR #163, @gageorsburn)

🪲 Bug Fixes

- Fixed issue with usernames not being passed as url encoded to Jellyseerr (PR #160, @WoolMagician)
- Sort "My Requests" section without media type grouping (PR #162, @ZorudaRinku)
- Fixed #142; Allow the user to choose with Radarr release types to consider in "Upcoming" (PR #164, @AdamWHY2K)

✨ New Features

- Updated to support 10.11.4
- PR#155 - Added support for internal/external jellyseerr urls. Thanks @botagas

✨ New Features

- Updated to support 10.11.3

🪲 Bug Fixes

- Fixed issue where user settings wouldn't correctly display enabled checkbox

🪲 Bug Fixes

- Fixed issue where MyRequests section could crash if results from Jellyseerr weren't found (#131)
- Fixed issue where users would potentially be shown items they don't have access to (#136)
- Fixed potential issue that could occur with upcoming posters if the user is hosting jellyfin in a subpath of their domain (#139 comment)
- Fixed potential crash that could occur in discover section (#141)
- Changed the ordering of sections to make use of css `flex-order` instead of relying on render order, makes the plugin more closer compatible with other plugins like KefinTweaks (#143)
- Fixed issue where the Modular Home settings weren't accessible after the first visit in a session
- Fixed issue where settings in the Modular Home screen wouldn't properly reflect the admin's configuration
- Made the non-overridable checkboxes disabled to better convey to the user what their home screen should look like

✨ New Features

- Updated to support 10.11.2

🪲 Bug Fixes

- Fixed issue where Recently Added Shows would be ordered wrong on 10.10.7 due to missing item field not being requested.

✨ New Features

- When failing to retrieve the home screen sections, instead of completely erroring, we now fallback to the default jellyfin behaviour. This should help with some issues during the install process.

🪲 Bug Fixes

- Fixed #128 where a crash was occurring when getting the Because You Watched sections
- Added logging to help diagnose the problems occurring in #125 (recently added shows appearing in the wrong order)

✨ New Features

- Added new "My Requests" section, building off the work done for the "Discover" sections, a new section is born, each user gets a row of movies/tv shows they have requested

⚡ Performance Improvements

- Minor optimisations to recently added sections
- Some of the code that handles sections has been refactored paving the way to allow the return of the heavily requested "Recently Added in {library}" sections, the default behaviour of Jellyfin.
    - Note this isn't added in this release, but soon it will be added.

🪲 Bug Fixes

- Fixed issue where Recently Added sections can duplicate content

🪲 Bug Fixes

- Fixed issue where some installs have legacy files that are no longer used, but get hooked stopping actual files from getting hooked #118
- Fixed issue where Recently Added Shows would display in Show date added order rather than Episode date added order #120

🪲 Bug Fixes

- There was an issue that could occur with the genre section which would result in an index out of range exception and no sections would appear on the server as reported in https://github.com/IAmParadox27/jellyfin-plugin-home-sections/issues/116. This has hopefully now been fixed.

🪲 Bug Fixes

- The Watch Again section wasn't working properly, this has now been fixed

⚡ Performance Improvements

- The Watch Again section has also had some TLC to its performance. Its still not perfect but has improved on my instance from 15 seconds to 6 seconds.

⚡ Performance Improvements

- The Genre section calculation has been drastically improved (I've seen my personal speeds drop from 8 seconds to 1 second for the calculation and 3 seconds to 250 ms for the results)
- The Because you watched section has been drastically improved (I've seen my personal speeds drop from 4 seconds to 1 second for the calculation and 3 seconds to 300ms for the results)

🪲 Bug Fixes

- The Recently Added sections lost support for hiding watched content, this has now been fixed.

✨ New Features

- Music Video Sections: Added music video library support to Latest and Recently Added sections
  - Closes #101
- Added Home Screen Sections as an option on the main dashboard sidebar for quicker access to modifying the settings.

🪲 Bug Fixes

- Fixed crash that can occur with the Genre section
  - Relates to #105
- Fixed another crash that could occur relating to the users display preferences
  - Relates to #105

🚨 Breaking Change

- Please be aware that due to a crash that was sometimes occurring when the home screen sections were being requested, support for the user's "home" settings from their profile has had to be temporarily removed. It is planned to bring this back but at this stage it is unknown when this will be.

🪲 Bug Fixes

- Fixed issue where TV shows weren't able to be requested in discover sections
- Fixed issue where request responses wouldn't give user feedback when the request was successful
- Fixed a minor formatting issue on the admin config page

✨ New Features

- Genre Section: Introduced a new genre section on the home screen (details explained below).
  - Closes https://features.iamparadox.dev/posts/20/versatile-home-sections
- Support for "My Media (small)". In the plugin settings, admin's can now select "Small" as a View Mode for My Media. If it's selected by anything else, it will revert back to Landscape when loaded by the client.
  - Closes https://github.com/IAmParadox27/jellyfin-plugin-home-sections/issues/81
- Added experimental Streamyfin integration (details explained below).
  - Fulfills the remaining requirements to https://github.com/streamyfin/streamyfin/issues/1108

🪲 Bug Fixes

- Fixed issue when requesting a Movie from Discover sections.
  - Closes https://github.com/IAmParadox27/jellyfin-plugin-home-sections/issues/96
- Fixed messaging issue that could occur from DiscoverRequest saying the item was requested successfully when an error had occurred.

🏃‍➡️ Performance and Code Improvements

- Home section calculation now uses parallelism, hopefully resulting in faster loading times on the home screen.
- Refactored some code Home screen controller code has been moved into a service for improved maintainability and easier future enhancements.

Genre Section

- This section is very early in development and may have issues, please open an issue on GitHub if you experience any issues.
- Set the number of times it should appear between 1 and N, it will appear a random number of times between those numbers.
- Each first request will calculate which Genres will appear on the home screen, this is based on a weighted scoring system that favours 'Favourites', 'Likes' and 'Recently Watched' per person. 
- A future release will bring the ability to restrict which genres are displayed, or even fix it to a certain list always, but that support is dependant on PR 70.

Streamyfin Integration

- In the Home Screen Sections plugin settings, admins will find an option to override the Streamyfin home sections with one's provided by HSS.
- Please note this requires plugin version 0.63.0.0 and a currently unreleased version of the app due to integration of a new Home Section type in Streamyfin, please be patient and wait for the release after v0.30.2 before making use of this setting.

🔒 Security Hotfix Release Notes

- Fixed issue with DiscoverRequest endpoint allowing any user to request on behalf of any user.

✨ Enhancements & Bug Fixes

- Fixed issue where TV shows couldn't be requested in discover section
- Adding ability for admins to configure whether each section should show/hide played content
- Changed Jellyseerr API key to be masked
- Fixed some issues with the cache bust text
- Added authorize to discover request fixing security vulnerability highlighted in #93
